title: Doctrinal Defense of the Gospel
summary: The Gospel is the good news that Jesus Christ died for sins, was buried, and rose again on the third day. Salvation is by grace through faith, not by works.
historical_context: The Gospel message was proclaimed immediately after the resurrection and forms the foundation of apostolic preaching.
major_points: Christ bore sin in our place
Salvation is a gift of grace

title: Biblical Defense of the Trinity
summary: Scripture reveals one God in three distinct Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Each Person is fully divine, yet there is one God.
historical_context: Early believers affirmed Christ’s deity and the Spirit’s deity based on Scripture, defending against false teachings.
major_points: The Holy Spirit is called God
The Persons are distinct yet unified

title: Defense of Messianic Prophecy Fulfillment
summary: Jesus fulfilled Old Testament prophecies written centuries before His birth, confirming His identity as the Messiah.
historical_context: These prophecies were recorded long before the first century and align with the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus.

title: Historical Reliability of the Gospel Accounts
summary: The Gospel accounts are supported by early creeds, eyewitness testimony, and consistent manuscript transmission.
historical_context: The resurrection proclamation began within years of the crucifixion, based on eyewitness testimony.
major_points: Willingness of apostles to suffer persecution

title: Biblical Salvation Clarification
summary: Salvation is received through repentance and faith in Jesus Christ alone. It is not earned by works but granted by grace.
historical_context: Apostolic preaching consistently declared salvation exclusively through Jesus Christ.
major_points: No other name under heaven saves

title: Logical Apologetic Responses Based on Scripture
summary: Scripture provides coherent answers to common objections against Christianity, affirming the truth of the Gospel.
historical_context: The apostles defended the faith publicly before rulers and skeptics using reasoned argument and eyewitness testimony.
major_points: Faith is not blind but evidence-based
